question: Motion to Proceed to S. 4668 — A bill to protect the name, image, and likeness rights of, and provide protections for, student athletes and to promote fair competition among intercollegiate athletics, and for other purposes.
plain_language: This vote starts formal consideration of the college-sports bill on athletes' name, image, and likeness rights, agents, and transfers. A Yea takes up the bill. A Nay refuses to take it up.
